about: How the train gets energy, EverRail's way: it charges while it moves (rule_drive_energy near its ideal speed) and drains all the time (rule_base_energy), so standing still empties it. 7 Days fuel only jump-starts a stalled locomotive (throttle_seconds x (rule_base_energy + rule_drive_energy) E per item); late-game add-ons are 7 Days' own Generator Bank and Battery Bank built inside a wagon room, and solar cells installed as panels on the train's roof.

rows.consumes: rule_base_energy all the time; gains rule_drive_energy near ideal speed; slope and regen rules
